title: Up in the sky
what: Under everything on the floating islands: air, light and calm. Loops.
prompt: Ambience loop: open air high above the clouds on a calm sunny day, a steady airy breeze with a faint soft whistle, spacious and peaceful, no birds, no voices, no music

title: Inside the cluster
what: The dark machine hall where the model runs, chapters 8 to 19. Loops.
prompt: Ambience loop: inside a quiet modern data center, a deep steady hum of server fans and cool air moving through racks, faint electrical whir, calm and huge, no beeps, no voices, no music

title: Inside the harness
what: The warm cream room the side trip drops into. Loops.
prompt: Ambience loop: a small warm wooden workshop room, a faint low mechanical hum and very distant clockwork ticking, cozy and close, no voices, no music

title: Drawer slides out
what: A harness drawer (or a hatch inside it) comes out on its runners.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small enamel cabinet drawer slides out smoothly on metal ball-bearing runners and stops with a soft click

title: Drawer slides shut
what: The same drawer going back in.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small enamel cabinet drawer pushed shut on metal ball-bearing runners, closing with a solid soft thud

title: Little motor
what: A small motor moving a part: the turn going round the loop, the gate arm lifting, the press rising.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small precise servo motor whirring for a moment as a toy mechanism moves, clean, then stops

title: Cartridge pops out
what: A tool cartridge springs out of its slot on Run, or clicks back in.
prompt: Foley close-up: a plastic cartridge clicking out of a spring-loaded slot, crisp satisfying latch click

title: The press comes down
what: The press on Write down squeezes the pages of what's sent into one summary.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small metal hand press comes down firmly on a stack of paper, a solid muffled thump with a little mechanical clank

title: Into the pipe
what: A message leaves down a pipe to the model.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small pneumatic tube system, a capsule sucked into the tube with a short whoosh and a soft thunk

title: Tape winding onto a reel
what: The saved transcript winding onto its reel. Loops while it winds.
prompt: Foley loop: a paper tape steadily winding onto a small reel, soft continuous rustle with a faint motor hum

title: A sheet lands
what: A sheet arriving in its place: on Pack, on the pile, on top of Run.
prompt: Foley close-up: a single stiff card sheet dropped flat onto a table, a crisp light paper slap

title: A sheet slides
what: A sheet lifting out of a folder or standing up.
prompt: Foley close-up: a stiff paper card slid quickly out of a folder, crisp short paper swish

title: Paper rolls up
what: A page rolling up, or a strip winding on.
prompt: Foley close-up: a sheet of thick paper rolled up quickly into a tube, crisp crinkle and rustle

title: Conveyor belt
what: The little rubber belt that carries tokens along. Loops while it runs.
prompt: Foley loop: a small rubber conveyor belt running steadily over metal rollers, soft rhythmic rolling and faint clicking, close

title: Brass gears
what: The gears turning behind the window in the model's brain. Loops.
prompt: Foley loop: small brass clockwork gears meshing and turning steadily, fine ticking and soft metallic whir, close

title: The cutter
what: The tokenizer's blade coming down on a strip of text.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small paper guillotine blade comes down and cuts a strip of card, one crisp clean snick

title: Down the wire
what: The request shooting through the tunnel to the provider.
prompt: Foley: a capsule shooting through a long pneumatic tube, a fast rushing whoosh that travels away into the distance

title: A check passes
what: A gate or checkpoint approving something: a firm stamp.
prompt: Foley close-up: a rubber stamp pressed firmly onto paper on a wooden desk, one solid satisfying thunk

title: No go
what: A gate refuses a call and its red light comes on: a short alarm.
prompt: Foley close-up: a short mechanical warning buzzer on a small factory gate, two quick low electric buzzes, bzzt bzzt, then silence, dry, no voice, no music

title: Safety scan
what: Tokens passing under the safety arch's light.
prompt: Foley: a short electronic scanner sweep, a soft rising hum with a faint shimmer, clean, like a barcode scanner but smoother

title: A block slots in
what: A memory block sliding into its place in the cache.
prompt: Foley close-up: a small plastic block slides into a snug slot and seats with a firm click

title: Chips switching
what: Work moving between the chips inside the cluster.
prompt: Foley close-up: a quick burst of small electrical relays clicking in sequence, crisp and precise

title: The whole world rises
what: The last chapter, when everything comes into view at once.
prompt: A deep slow mechanical rumble rising and settling, large machinery moving into place, smooth and grand, ending with a soft heavy thud

title: Kalimba note
what: One plucked note, retuned to play every tune in the story.
prompt: A single kalimba note, one clean pluck of a metal tine, warm and bright with a natural ringing decay, close-mic, dry, nothing else

title: Marimba note
what: One struck wooden note, retuned to play every tune in the story.
prompt: A single marimba note, one rosewood bar struck once with a soft yarn mallet, warm round tone with natural decay, close-mic, dry, nothing else

title: Music box note
what: One delicate plucked comb tooth, retuned to play every tune.
prompt: A single music box note, one steel comb tooth plucked once, clear and delicate with a natural ringing decay, close-mic, dry, nothing else

title: Wheel peg
what: The flapper hitting one peg on the sampling wheel.
prompt: Foley close-up: a flexible plastic flapper flicking past one wooden peg on a spinning prize wheel, a single crisp tick

title: Key press
what: A key going down on the laptop, and the terminal typing.
prompt: Foley close-up: a single laptop keyboard key pressed and released, crisp soft click

title: Swoosh
what: Something flying past: the camera's flights, cards through the air.
prompt: A soft smooth swoosh of air, like a stiff paper card swept quickly past the ear, gentle and clean

title: Wooden clonk
what: A no: something not recognised, refused or full.
prompt: Foley close-up: a hollow wooden block knocked once on a wooden table, a muted low clonk

title: Little pop
what: A small thing appearing: a cell in a lane, a block popping up.
prompt: Foley close-up: a tiny soft plastic pop, like a small snap cap or a cork from a toy, cute and short

title: Tokenizer bot stamp
what: The cutter on its gantry stepping over and stamping down on the strip.
prompt: Foley: a small toy robot arm stamping down once, a quick little servo whirr then a crisp satisfying mechanical ka-chunk

title: Board flips
what: The scheduler board changing what it says, like a split-flap sign.
prompt: Foley: a split-flap display board flipping to a new word, a quick flutter of small plastic flaps clicking into place

title: Shuttle sweeps
what: The bridge sweeping across the lanes, once per step of the model.
prompt: Foley: a small carriage sliding quickly along a metal rail from one end to the other, smooth rolling whir ending in a soft stop

title: Something grows
what: Threads and branches growing through the transformer.
prompt: A soft magical growing sound, a gentle rising shimmer of glassy harmonics like a vine sprouting in a cartoon, airy and delicate, no music

title: Domino set down
what: A token tile landing on the embedding floor of the transformer.
prompt: Foley close-up: a single heavy ivory domino tile set down flat onto a polished wooden table, one crisp hard clack, dry, nothing else

title: Harp string
what: One line of attention: "job" reaching back to an earlier token. Thicker lines play lower.
prompt: A single harp string plucked once, warm round nylon tone with a natural ringing decay, close-mic, dry, nothing else

title: Harp sweep
what: Attention everywhere at once: the webs of arcs between every token, on every layer.
prompt: A quick gentle harp glissando sweeping upward across the strings, light and shimmering, close-mic, dry, nothing else

title: Filling up
what: The context gauge rising toward its limit.
prompt: Foley: water steadily filling a tall narrow glass tube, rising gurgle with rising pitch

title: Around the brain
what: Under the model while it's in view: a mind at work. Loops.
prompt: Ambient loop: a dreamy warm hum with soft distant twinkling chimes and slow gentle swells, calm and magical, like a mind thinking, no beat, no voices
